title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Removal Processing Fee by Homeowner Tier
content:
**Fee schedule.** The removal processing fee on removing an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider follows the current tier of the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract:

| Current tier of the base homeowner contract | Removal processing fee |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum | Zero |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | Zero |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Silver | USD 15.00 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze | USD 15.00 |
| Any other tier | USD 25.00 |
| A base that is not a homeowner contract | USD 25.00 |

The tier read is the base homeowner contract's current tier as recorded on that contract.

**Hypothetical cases.** A rider on a Bridgewell SystemsCare contract: USD 25.00. A rider on a Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze contract: USD 15.00. A rider on a rental property service contract: USD 25.00.
